text: In May 2025, City Council adopted recommendations from the Ombudsman related to the City’s response to a six-month vital services outage in an unlicensed multi-tenant house (MTH) in 2023, and provided additional directives to staff to ensure supports are in place for tenants ( 2025.CC30.3 ). In September 2023, following a fire in a multi-tenant home, utility providers shut off natural gas and some of the electricity. Tenants called the City for assistance to restore vital services, and ten of the eleven tenants ended up moving out as the outage lasted for six months. Addressing vital services disruptions to prevent tenant displacement, and supporting those who become displaced, is a multi-divisional collaborative effort by Municipal Licensing and Standards (MLS), the Housing Secretariat (HS), and Toronto Emergency Management (TEM).
